# MeshCore.js browser bundle

`meshcore.js` is generated from `@liamcottle/meshcore.js` v1.15.1 by
`npm run build:meshcore`. Only the browser BLE/serial connections and protocol
constants are included.

Upstream: https://github.com/meshcore-dev/meshcore.js
